title: Kth Largest
statement: Implement `solve(nums, k)`. Return the kth largest integer in `nums`, where `k` is 1-based. Duplicates count separately, so in `[3, 3]` the first and second largest are both 3. `k` is between 1 and the length.
hints: A min-heap of size k holds the largest k values seen so far.
Push each number. If the heap exceeds k, pop the smallest of those k.
The root is the kth largest.

approaches.name: Min-heap of size k
approaches.explanation: Sorting descending and indexing k-1 is correct and uses more comparisons than you need when k is small.

editorial: Sorting descending and indexing k-1 is correct and uses more comparisons than you need when k is small. A min-heap of size k stays at the k largest values. Its root is the smallest of those, which is the kth largest overall.
